scope: Oye campus Phases 1, 2 and 3. Imagery-guided area of interest; not an official property boundary.

footprints.geometry: OSM/Microsoft mapped polygons plus explicitly attributed local visual roof traces; 108 building polygons at this checkpoint.

observations.notes: New Senate and eight unnamed roofs are approximate visual traces, not surveyed walls. Source image acquisition dates unavailable.

roads.geometry: OSM centre lines plus attributed local observations of campus access and park paths.

terrain.source: Mapzen Terrain Tiles / global terrain data courtesy of USGS
terrain.processing: Terrarium decoding, 3x3 weighted elevation smoothing for DEM/canopy noise, bilinear grid sampling, polygon foundation grading with a 35m transition and rendered triangle interpolation; no vertical exaggeration; observed ground areas clipped to the exact terrain triangles to avoid intersecting independently tessellated surfaces

observed: 11 place identities matched to pins or compounds with explicit match types
Four-storey boys hostel; cream/terracotta facade; green roof
Two-storey Management Sciences with tall cream columns and upper frontage glazing
Administration compound with cream/orange facade treatment
Roof colours and outlines visible in satellite imagery
architecture.limitations: Maps listing matches do not certify present occupancy. Photo-informed models are approximations. Current page access and copyright dates do not establish current imagery.

landscape.processing: Oye window read from public cloud-optimized GeoTIFF. Class 10 drives background tree placement and other classes tint terrain. Shared, spatially chunked instances, maximum 3200 trees; at most 480 nearby broadleaf trees use detailed crowns and branches. Phase 1 planting overrides follow approximate satellite observations.
landscape.limitations: ESA 2021 classification, not a current tree survey. Individual trees, species, heights, vehicles and lamps are estimated. Eight ground areas and seven path/access observations follow the inspected imagery; their edges/materials are approximate. Phase 1 hedge runs and kerbs are illustrative treatments within visible planted areas.

textures: Locally generated canvas textures; no third-party texture assets

reference.author: 0xbigturk
reference.use: Behavior and visual layout reference. Application implementation and textures are original. No reference buildings or downloaded reference code are served.

entrance.identity: User confirmed main entrance beside Phase 1
entrance.limitations: Satellite/photo correspondence is a visual inference; image capture date and exact dimensions unknown. Gate sculpture, flags, walls and graded approach are approximations. Photograph is not served as a runtime asset.

identification.nameplates: Inventory-backed primary buildings; generated signs, not transcriptions of every real facade sign.
identification.phaseMarkers: App-added campus guide signs; locations approximate.
identification.wemaBank: Excluded from this work at the user's request; no footprint assigned.

phase1VisualPass.changes: Separate southern lawn, eastern garden and northern tree verge; tall hall windows and facade trim; grouped nearby tree crowns and shared procedural foliage texture.
phase1VisualPass.limitations: Saved May 2022 interior photo supports a tall single-storey hall. Exterior detailing, window dimensions and roof construction remain inferred. Saved satellite capture date unknown. Official exterior image could not be accessed and was not used.

campusVisualPass.evidence: Existing saved Maps contributor photos: Management Sciences (November 2021), boys hostel (November 2022), Administration (October 2021); existing traced park and paths. No new imagery downloaded.
campusVisualPass.changes: Management frontage glazing, columns and paired doors; hostel louvres, recessed bays and balcony rails; Administration projecting orange frames and wide louvre windows; named-building reveals and aprons; park/path edging.
campusVisualPass.limitations: Dimensions and detailed window placement inferred from single views. Unphotographed facades, including Senate, retain estimated profiles and mapped outlines. Kerbs and aprons are illustrative. No invented park areas or surveyed tree positions.
